stem: A die is thrown, so the sample space is $S=\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\}$. Write the event $A$ = the event of getting an even number: tap on the number line every outcome in $A$.
solution: Go through each outcome and keep those that are even.

hints.text: Go through every outcome of S one by one and ask whether it is even. Some outcomes in the event are still unmarked.
Check each marked outcome again: does it satisfy the condition of the event?
Check each marked outcome against the condition of the event.

notes: Event as a set of outcomes; matches book answer {2,4,6}.
